description_for_human: Read synthetic mail and purchase orders through authenticated APIM.
description_for_model: Read current synthetic records from the private backend. Every operation returns fresh backend observation metadata. Pass the user's exact record ID and nonce. Errors are not successful record reads.

functions.name: getMail
functions.description: Read one synthetic mail record and live backend observation metadata.

functions.name: getPurchaseOrder
functions.description: Read one synthetic SAP-shaped purchase order. Zero quantity or value is valid; HTTP 404 means missing.

functions.name: getHealth
functions.description: Read current private-backend health with fresh observation metadata.
